text: Received contact report from BANG; increased speed to 17 knots on course 180°T.
Contact report from PARCHE.
Contact report from BANG; came to course to intercept at 20 knots.
PARCHE dove … after having informed us that she would make first attack on the port flank of the convoy.
Sighted a patrol plane covering the convoy. With plane coverage, a bright sky and a glassy sea, I could only use about 6 inches of periscope.
First of a series of 42 depth charges from the vicinity of the PARCHE.
Two depth charges, not close … followed shortly thereafter by a series of 21 more depth charges within the next 14 minutes.
One AK was observed before firing to have a port list and was heavy aft. She must have been damaged by BANG or PARCHE.
Sighted masts of seven or more large ships, bearing 310°T, distance 8 miles.
Sent first contact report to PARCHE and BANG. Sent contact reports each hour until 1200 (H), while trailing convoy.
Received contact report from TINOSA. Surfaced and began chase.
Radar interference, so assumed it to be PARCHE or BANG. Kept at a safe range. We should have IFF on SJ Radar for use with coordinated attacks.
PARCHE asked for positions of all submarines. Our transmitter was out of commission, so could not report.
Ahead of convoy … Eased to starboard side to clear BANG who had received orders to attack from the port flank.
With clear bright moonlight, could not stay at radar depth long enough for radar to be of much advantage without danger of being sighted.
Observed first hit in Tanker under her bridge … One hit heard but did not see it, as was watching Tanker go down. Sank: Lat. 20-51N Long. 118-02E.
Series of distant explosions; one of the other boats evidently attacking.
Went deep. … Received a total of 55 depth charges.
Target completely gone. … Not a single depth charge heard. The Japs were completely in the dark as to what was going on.
Message from PARCHE to report position. Could not answer; transmitter still out of commission.
Heard 9 explosions. Thought possibly PARCHE was making another attack or maybe the Nips thought they were depth charging us.
Transmitter back in commission, sent position and results of attack to PARCHE.
Heard 48 explosions (0712 to 0733).
